repository.description: Flexible and powerful data analysis / manipulation library for Python, providing labeled data structures similar to R data.frame objects, statistical functions, and much more

issue.body:
First, an example that works as expected (non-categorical):

``` python

Out[24]: 
z     0     1     2
y                  
0  24.0  25.0  24.5
1  73.5  74.5  74.0

In [25]: data.pivot_table('x', 'y', 'z', margins=True)
Out[25]: 
z       0     1     2   All
y                          
0    24.0  25.0  24.5  24.5
1    73.5  74.5  74.0  74.0
All  48.0  49.0  50.0  49.0
```
